visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young Asian man with dark, styled hair wears a light purple button-down shirt over a white tee. He stands outdoors on a city street with a white wall behind him. Large yellow vertical text "延三商圈" is on the left. He smiles, showing teeth, and gestures with one finger raised near his head. (2) The man stands in a narrow urban alley with weathered building walls. He holds several white paper scrolls. He looks down, selects one, and unrolls it to reveal handwritten text "小龍包!". He shows a surprised facial expression with wide eyes. (3) Close-up shot of a round bamboo steamer basket filled with several small, white dumplings. The scene transitions to the man indoors sitting at a table. He uses wooden chopsticks to pick up a dumpling, revealing a meat filling. He closes his eyes and bites into it with visible enjoyment. (4) Back outdoors, the man appears confused or thinking. He looks to the side with an exaggerated pouting face. A yellow text box with "包?" and a white drawing of a thinking bubble appears next to his head. The background shows a street with parked scooters. (5) The man is inside a brightly lit, modern cafe with dark wooden accents. He holds a small white ceramic cup and sips tea. He then holds up a small, dark green square piece of food, likely chocolate, examining it closely while speaking to the camera. (6) The man is outdoors at night or under a canopy, pointing upwards at a colorful food stall sign with various menu items listed. He then looks at a white ceramic bowl containing a steamed egg dish topped with corn and a pink swirl fish cake. (7) Standing in front of a blue and white "Watsons" storefront, the man holds two purple mouthwash bottles. Inside the store, he stands in an aisle filled with oral care products, pointing to different colored Listerine bottles on the shelf and looking directly at the lens. (8) The man is in a clean, white-walled bathroom setting. He holds a bottle of purple liquid, pours it into a clear cap, and then puts the liquid in his mouth. He swishes the liquid around with puffed cheeks and closed eyes, demonstrating the product use. (9) Returning to the retail store environment, the man stands holding three different Listerine products: a large purple bottle, a smaller green bottle, and a green spray. He smiles broadly and leans towards the camera, presenting the products as a group.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-arousal, fast-paced male voice speaking in Mandarin. The background music is an upbeat, electronic pop track with a clear 4/4 beat and steady synth melody. A sharp "whoosh" sound effect marks a visual transition. (2) As the speaker's tone shifts to a questioning inflection, the sound of paper crinkling and rustling is heard as he handles scrolls. The BGM remains constant in tempo. A light "ding" sound effect emphasizes a moment of discovery. (3) The acoustic environment shifts to a more enclosed space with a slight reverb. Faint clinking of ceramics and muffled background chatter of a restaurant are audible. The speaker's voice is slightly muffled as if talking while eating, with an appreciative tone. (4) Outdoor ambient noise increases, featuring a low-frequency hum of distant traffic. The speaker's voice becomes more contemplative with longer pauses. A short, synthesized "boing" sound effect occurs when a question is posed. (5) The scene transitions to a quiet indoor atmosphere. The sound of liquid pouring into a ceramic cup creates a crisp, splashy transient. The BGM changes to a more relaxed, lo-fi chill beat with muted percussion and soft synth pads. (6) A sudden increase in vocal intensity occurs as the speaker sounds excited again. A bright "shing" transition sound is followed by the delicate sound of a spoon hitting a ceramic bowl. The primary BGM resumes its energetic pace. (7) The audio moves to a commercial retail environment with a flat, clean acoustic profile. The speaker adopts a professional, narrative tone with clear articulation. Several "pop" and "ping" UI sound effects are layered over the speech for emphasis. (8) The sound of a plastic bottle cap being unscrewed and liquid being poured is prominent. This is followed by a distinct "gurgling" or "swishing" sound of liquid being moved around the mouth. The BGM volume ducks slightly to prioritize these Foley sounds. (9) The finale features high-energy speech with a rising pitch contour, indicating a call to action. The BGM swells in volume with a more driving beat. A final bright synthesizer chime marks the end of the promotional segment.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Food Chain Challenge -> Product Integration -> Benefit Demonstration -> Retail Promotion -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote Listerine mouthwash products by integrating them into a relatable 'food chain' challenge in a popular shopping district. The video aims to show that after enjoying various foods, oral care is essential, showcasing the product's effectiveness and current retail discounts.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct presentation of Listerine products, demonstration of use, explanation of medical benefits, and detailed retail pricing/discount information.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly produced commercial vlog that effectively uses fast-paced editing and a popular local context to maintain engagement while delivering a dense marketing message.
